# 0.6.1 beta 9 — Clear device help and simpler native targets

- Make per-device information bubbles explain the effects of On and Off,
  applicable modes, independent controls and the conditions that can hold an
  action. Preserve the compact icon-and-state row, readable mobile help and
  exact device ownership.
- Rename **Device errors** to **Announce device errors**. Disabling it stops
  that device's error announcements while retaining fault detection, status
  and device protections.
- Rename **Full-output setpoint** to **Maximum target by mode**, followed by
  the actual supported target modes of that device. Translate the label and
  mode names in all 38 supported languages. Heating/humidifying request the
  native maximum; cooling/dehumidifying request the native minimum. Turning
  the option off leaves the native target unchanged.
- Rename **When all asleep** to **Keep device off when all asleep**, and make
  the enabled preference enforce OFF for Automatic/PID devices when at least
  one room is occupied and all occupied rooms are confirmed asleep. Keep
  physical operating protections and release the household hold for an awake
  occupant or configured alarm preparation. Empty or unknown occupancy does
  not prove everyone is asleep; separate room sleep and presence rules remain.
- Remove the **Timed setpoints (30 s)** option, its switch and new timing
  behavior. Ignore and clean up old enabled preferences. Apply an enabled
  maximum native target after native ON is confirmed and request guarded OFF
  directly when stopping is permitted. Existing interrupted shutdowns retain
  their original power acknowledgement and ownership checks without creating
  another reverse-target write or a new 30-second wait.
- Retain the three-attempt limit for unconfirmed PID maximum targets, actual
  device feedback, staged fan quiet limits and the window-announcement rules.

Install **0.6.1b9**, restart Home Assistant and refresh the HEM card. The retired
timing preference cannot re-enable the removed behavior. Existing releases,
tags and assets are retained.
